instruction: On Hugging Face, open the Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-GGUF model repository. The Q4_K_M quantization is split across several files. Download the second part of the Q4_K_M quantization. The first part and the parts of any other quantization, such as Q5_K_M, do not qualify. A saved file is not required; the outcome is initiation of the correct download.
